versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Salary Intelligence skill.
- Provides EU salary data across 30+ countries with NACE sector and ISCO occupation classification.
- Includes AI job displacement risk indicators and OECD exposure data.
- Offers detailed wage statistics for Latvia from the Central Statistical Bureau (CSP).
- Methods for salary overviews, AI risk analysis, and Latvia wage data accessible via simple API endpoints.
- Useful for salary research, AI risk assessment, and economic analysis involving labor and wages.
